projectContext: Sprint 34 continues pipeline improvements after Mullvad VPN integration (Sprint 33). Focus areas: (1) Enhanced download resilience with connection pooling and DNS caching, (2) Pipeline telemetry and observability, (3) Documentation updates reflecting the 4-tier escalation system, (4) Test coverage for edge cases in stages. Key integration points: src/pipeline.py (orchestrator), src/stages/*.py (stage implementations), src/downloader/core.py (download logic), src/agents/runner.py (self-healing).
